feature: Exact rational initial conditions for bounded Bernoulli ODE families

implementation.observations: Built-in dictionary of exact rational function values; transformed values bounded to 1024 bits before exponentiation.
implementation.branch_selection: Reciprocal or signed quadratic graph checked at every supplied original observation. Quadratic initial conditions require simplify=True.
implementation.zero_solution: Positive nonlinear exponents admit y=0 only when every observation is zero and no reciprocal occurs in the original retained source.
refusals: Derivative, symbolic, approximate or foreign observations
Conflicting data or an unverified transcendental comparison
Implicit higher-power relations that cannot identify the prescribed nonzero branch
implementation.scope: Local solutions only; no global interval, complete profile, portable proof or claim-tier promotion.

isolated_math.result: Exact original nonlinear ODE and initial-value residuals are zero for the centered transformed-family formula. This does not execute FrankenSymPy.
